name: Sumter
gaps: Source query returned 7347 rows; 6759 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are Parcel (Sumter City/County) (https://gis.sumter-sc.com/server/rest/services/BaseMaps/Sumter_City_County/FeatureServer/7). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Sale price/date not on parcel attributes; use qPublic WebURL / AppID 1154.
FLU separate layer not verified on dig day.
